title: BioChemEntity
description: Any biological, chemical, or biochemical thing. For example: a protein; a gene; a chemical; a synthetic chemical.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

associatedDisease.title: Associated Disease
associatedDisease.description: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PropertyValue [value-type]: PropertyValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; MedicalCondition [entity]: MedicalCondition -> MedicalEntity -> Thing

bioChemInteraction.title: Bio Chem Interaction
bioChemInteraction.description: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

bioChemSimilarity.title: Bio Chem Similarity
bioChemSimilarity.description: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

biologicalRole.title: Biological Role
biologicalRole.description: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

hasBioChemEntityPart.title: Has Bio Chem Entity Part
hasBioChemEntityPart.description: Indicates a BioChemEntity that (in some sense) has this BioChemEntity as a part.

hasMolecularFunction.title: Has Molecular Function
hasMolecularFunction.description: Molecular function performed by this BioChemEntity; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PropertyValue [value-type]: PropertyValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; DefinedTerm [entity]: DefinedTerm -> Intangible -> Thing

hasRepresentation.title: Has Representation
hasRepresentation.description: A common representation such as a protein sequence or chemical structure for this entity. For images use schema.org/image.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PropertyValue [value-type]: PropertyValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing

isEncodedByBioChemEntity.title: Is Encoded By Bio Chem Entity
isEncodedByBioChemEntity.description: Another BioChemEntity encoding by this one.

isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess.title: Is Involved In Biological Process
isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess.description: Biological process this BioChemEntity is involved in; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PropertyValue [value-type]: PropertyValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; DefinedTerm [entity]: DefinedTerm -> Intangible -> Thing

isLocatedInSubcellularLocation.title: Is Located In Subcellular Location
isLocatedInSubcellularLocation.description: Subcellular location where this BioChemEntity is located; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PropertyValue [value-type]: PropertyValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; DefinedTerm [entity]: DefinedTerm -> Intangible -> Thing

isPartOfBioChemEntity.title: Is Part Of Bio Chem Entity
isPartOfBioChemEntity.description: Indicates a BioChemEntity that is (in some sense) a part of this BioChemEntity.

taxonomicRange.title: Taxonomic Range
taxonomicRange.description: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.

taxonomicRange_text.title: Taxonomic Range (text)
taxonomicRange_text.description: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.
